defects.detail: Atom TW5-WORKEXEC-SUCC-005 uses target_2_0_action=RESEARCH, but INGEST_PACKET_SCHEMA permits only KEEP, REPAIR, ADAPT_TO_GRID, REPLACE_WITH_VERIFIED_SUCCESSOR, COMPATIBILITY_ONLY, RETIRE_WITH_EVIDENCE, UNDECIDED.

Atom TW5-WORKEXEC-SUCC-002 binds the handoff->spawn->reconcile claim to architekt_governance.md lines 1-7. Exact donor source shows the relevant statement at lines 76-81; lines 1-7 describe cadence/governance, not delegation ordering.

The packet leaves Agent PostToolUse tool_response -> child identity as unestablished. Current official Claude Code hooks documentation explicitly documents tool_response.agentId for completed and async-launched Agent calls, while SubagentStart/SubagentStop expose agent_id.

source_checked_atoms.what_it_does: handoff() persists entityos_arbeitspaket and compiles a deterministic transfer capsule, while explicitly stating that stern itself delegates/spawns nothing.
The donor spec requires stern.py handoff before spawning and stern.py reconcile afterwards, with lastschutz before parallel build-agent spawning.

The donor plugin registers SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd and PreCompact only; it does not itself register SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated or TaskCompleted lifecycle hooks.

external_primary_correction.source: Claude Code official hooks reference observed 2026-08-28
observed_capabilities: PostToolUse for Agent documents tool_response.agentId on completed calls and async-launched background calls.
TaskCreated/TaskCompleted document task_id as a separate task-system identity.
external_primary_correction.field_normalization: agentId in Agent tool_response and agent_id in lifecycle hooks are distinct field spellings and must be explicitly normalized only after equality is observed or version-contractually guaranteed.
external_primary_correction.task_id_policy: OPTIONAL_SEPARATE_IDENTITY_DOMAIN; do not require or alias task_id for ordinary subagent execution unless the concrete task path emits it.

frankenstein_2_0_architecture_change.previous_open_question: A deterministic tool_use_id-to-agent_id join may be unavailable and could require transcript/timing heuristics.
frankenstein_2_0_architecture_change.updated_design: Prefer a version-gated WorkExecutionBinding that records package_id, tool_use_id, Agent tool_response.agentId, lifecycle agent_id, optional task_id, generation, parent session and result/receipt refs as distinct fields. Reject timing/order-only joins. The documented Agent response bridge removes the need to design around an assumed missing shared child identifier, but installed-runtime capture remains mandatory before executable credit.

binding_rules: package_id alone is delegated-work intent, not child execution proof
session_id is context, never sufficient invocation identity
tool_use_id is the parent call identity
agentId/agent_id is the child execution identity
task_id remains a separate optional task-system identity
no timestamp/order heuristic may synthesize a missing edge
retry/resume/replacement creates an explicit successor/supersession relation rather than mutating historical identity
binding evidence does not mint completion truth; completion remains separately receipt-gated

contradictions_preserved: Donor handoff is runtime-reachable bookkeeping but not a spawn implementation.
Donor spec expects handoff -> spawn -> reconcile, while donor hook config does not capture child lifecycle.
Official current platform docs expose a plausible exact child identifier bridge, but target-host installed-version/runtime emission is still unobserved.
A host-private hook configuration could already capture lifecycle events outside the donor plugin; repository absence is not proof of host absence.

next_discriminators.action: On an authorized non-provider local/sandbox host, capture one harmless Agent invocation with PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SubagentStart and SubagentStop and record exact tool_use_id, tool_response.agentId and agent_id fields; require exact equality/normalization and no timestamp heuristic.
Capture one background Agent launch because current docs state PostToolUse returns async_launched plus agentId; verify lifecycle continuity to SubagentStop and completion/result re-entry.
Inspect target host/plugin/global hook registrations before adding duplicate SubagentStart/SubagentStop hooks.
